title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Table of Student Enrolment and Satisfaction
prompt: The table below shows the number of students enrolled in four different course types at a language centre in 2019 and 2022, and the percentage of students who rated their course as 'satisfactory' or better in each year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作 Task 1 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据表格信息写一篇至少 150 词的报告，概括主要特征并进行比较。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
